title: The Mutual respect between them
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：mutual　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mutual 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the musician wrote of ① a mutual respect between them in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② so mutual that nobody in the hall would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the mutual ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the mutual respect between them that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too mutual to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the mutual ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a mutual friend of the two families, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as mutual as the friend of the two families they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was mutual or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something mutual, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite mutual; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the mutual ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, at once, she wrote of another mutual respect between them in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less mutual than anybody had expected. ⑩ The mutual friend of the two families that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the mutual ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 相互（前置定语 a mutual respect between them：1954 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件相互的尊重）
B. adj. 相互／共同（两处加强说法：so mutual that … 与 no less mutual than …）
C. adj. 相互／共同（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 相互（表语 too mutual to do：母亲觉得它太相互，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 共同（前置定语 a mutual friend of the two families：叔叔把整件事称作一桩共同的朋友）
F. adj. 共同（同级比较 as mutual as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩两家人共同的朋友相比）
G. adj. 共同（后置定语 something mutual：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 共同（受程度副词修饰 quite mutual：那位听客的评价）

items.q: the mutual respect between them that
a mutual friend of the two families
The mutual friend of the two families that

answers.why: mutual 意为“相互”，1954 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件相互的尊重”，此处作前置定语 a mutual respect between them。
mutual 意为“相互”，此处用 so mutual that 结构，说它相互到音乐厅里没人敢靠近。
mutual 意为“相互”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的相互彼此之间的相互尊重，等于最高级的说法。
mutual 意为“相互”，母亲认为这件东西“太相互了，谁也用不上”，too mutual to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
mutual 意为“共同”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩共同的朋友”，此处作前置定语 a mutual friend of the two families。
mutual 意为“共同”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩两家人共同的朋友一样共同”，同级比较用 as mutual as。
mutual 意为“共同”，节目单上那半行字要的是“共同的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something mutual。
mutual 意为“共同”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当共同”，quite 修饰原级 mutual。
mutual 意为“共同”，no less mutual than 表示“其共同不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之共同不亚于任何人的预料。
mutual 意为“共同”，母亲 1966 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的共同朋友”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件相互的尊重。（a mutual respect between them）
它相互到音乐厅里没有一个人敢靠近。（so mutual that …）
母亲觉得它太相互，谁也用不上。（too mutual to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩共同的朋友。（a mutual friend of the two families）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩两家人共同的朋友一样共同。（as mutual as …）
到了 1961 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件共同的东西。（something mutual）
answers: In 1954 the musician wrote of a mutual respect between them in the programme.
It was so mutual that nobody in the hall would go near it.
My mother thought it too mutual to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a mutual friend of the two families.
He said nobody would call it as mutual as the friend of the two families they had once had.
By 1961 the programme asked for nothing but something mutual.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 mutual 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the musician wrote of a mutual respect between them in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the mutual respect between them that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too mutual to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a mutual friend of the two families, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite mutual, and everybody laughed.
The mutual ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
